commitResults.messageTitle: Explain how editp and delp keep appointments in sync in the DG
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG's Implementation section only covered delnote, although
renaming and deleting pets is where pet and appointment data must
stay consistent.

Add a section with a sequence diagram for editp, explain how delp
reuses the same path, and record why appointments refer to pets by
name rather than by object or ID.

commitResults.messageTitle: Link to the existing pet-link design note instead of repeating it
commitResults.messageBody:
The new editp and delp section repeated the design consideration on
how appointments refer to pets, which the Model section already has.
Link to that one, and record a decision specific to these commands
instead: completed sessions keep a pet's old name and are not deleted
with the pet.
